title: Sri Lanka Group Tour | Top Destinations & Must-Do Experiences
highlights: Relish daily breakfast & dinner at your hotels, allowing you to enjoy delicious meals every day while focusing entirely on exploring Sri Lanka's beautiful destinations.
Get to ride the world-famous first-class train from Ambewela to Ella with tickets pre-included & witness breath-taking views of rolling tea plantations & misty mountains.
Enjoy seamless travel with an expert English-speaking chauffeur, ensuring an insightful sightseeing & experience throughout your tour.
Witness a complimentary traditional Cultural Show, thoughtfully included in your itinerary to offer an immersive glimpse into Sri Lanka's vibrant music, dance & rich heritage.
Travel with complete peace of mind knowing that all airport assistance with transfers along with sightseeing transportation are taken care of, allowing you to enjoy a truly hassle-free holiday.

Tips and Gratuities: Driver, Guide, and Hotel Staff
know_before_you_go: Guests are advised to ensure that their passports are valid for at least six months from the date of arrival in Sri Lanka and that the required visa has been obtained before departure.
It is recommended that guests schedule their arrival flight between 05:00 AM and 09:00 AM on the first day to comfortably join the shared airport transfer.
Guests arriving on different flights should note that the shared transfer departs the airport at 11:00 AM, and the vehicle will not be able to wait beyond this scheduled departure time.
On the final day, it is advisable to book departure flights from 05:00 PM onwards to allow sufficient time for the transfer to the airport.
Hotel check-in is from 2:00 PM, while check-out is by 12:00 PM. Early check-in and late check-out are subject to availability and the discretion of the hotel.

The hotels mentioned in the itinerary are subject to availability. In the event of unavailability, similar-category hotels may be arranged, and any applicable cost difference may be communicated accordingly.
The package includes daily breakfast and dinner at the hotels. Lunch, beverages beyond the meal plan, and personal expenses are not included.
Entrance fees to attractions, boat rides, water sports, and any optional activities are payable separately unless specifically mentioned as included.
Comfortable walking shoes are highly recommended, as several sightseeing locations involve walking on uneven paths, gardens, railway viewpoints, temple premises, and natural attractions.

The train journey from Ambewela to Ella is included in the itinerary. Guests are advised to keep their essential belongings and valuables with them during the journey and to travel with luggage within the permitted allowance.
Wildlife encounters, elephant sightings, and turtle hatchery visits should be enjoyed responsibly. Guests are encouraged to avoid feeding or disturbing animals unless guided by authorized staff.
Guests are requested to follow the guidance of the chauffeur or tour guide regarding sightseeing timings to ensure the itinerary runs smoothly.

meal_plans.name: Bermuda Plan
meal_plans.description: The Bermuda meal plan offers three meals at select restaurants, including breakfast, lunch, and dinner along with drinks included. Ideal for a hassle-free, all-inclusive dining experience.

meal_plans.name: Dinner Plan
meal_plans.description: The Dinner Plan provides guests with two meals included in their stay: breakfast and dinner.

meal_plans.name: American Plan
meal_plans.description: It includes all three major meals, breakfast, lunch, and dinner for the length of your stay. Generally, the rates on this plan are higher but offer a good value for your money, and of course, added convenience.

meal_plans.name: Modified American Plan
meal_plans.description: Also known as Half Board or Half Pension meal plan. It is a modified version of the American Plan and includes a room stay with breakfast and a choice between lunch and dinner.

meal_plans.name: Continental Plan
meal_plans.description: It is where your room stay involves a daily breakfast at the hotel. The hotel can either affix its option of breakfast menu or provide in the dining area for a buffet breakfast. Also, whether the room service provides the breakfast or in a general dining area, depends from hotel to hotel.

meal_plans.name: European Plan
meal_plans.description: Only the stay is included in the rates and that you will have to pay extra for using the hotel’s dining facilities. This can be called the “Room Only” Plan.

days.title: Colombo to Kandy | Arrival, Pinnawala & Kandy Sightseeing
days.desc: Welcome! Once you reach at the airport, get driven to the hotel in Kandy. Enroute, make a stop & visit Pinnawala Elephant Orphanage, where you can enjoy watching elephant feeding & bathing session. Also, visit Temple of Tooth Relic, one of the country's most sacred sites. Don't miss Peradeniya Botanical Garden, famous for its giant trees & orchids. Do watch Kandyan Cultural Show, highlighting nation's culture. Then, get driven to the hotel & check in.

days.title: Kandy to Nuwara Eliya | Transfer & Hill Country Highlights
days.desc: Check out from the hotel & get driven to Nuwara Eliya. Enroute, make a stop at Ramboda Waterfalls, one of Sri Lanka's most beautiful cascades. Also, visit a tea factory to see how Ceylon tea is made. Explore Seetha Amman Temple, world's only temple dedicated to Goddess Sita & Hakgala Garden, known as the Ashok Vatika from the Ramayana. Don't miss Victoria Park and visit a strawberry farm before checking in to your hotel.

days.title: Nuwara Eliya to Ella | Train Journey & City Sightseeing
days.desc: Check out from the hotel & get driven to Ambewela Station. From there, take the scenic train to Ella. Enroute, marvel at Nine Arch Bridge, featuring nine arches set amid dense forests. Once you reach Ella Station, get driven to visit some of its sightseeing points. Explore Ravana Cave, linked to the legend of King Ravana & Ravana Waterfalls, cascading down rocky cliffs. Don't miss Divurumpola Temple, where Princess Sita performed Agni Pariksha. Then, get driven to the hotel & check in.

days.title: Ella to Bentota | Free Time in the City
days.desc: Check out from the hotel & get driven to Bentot. Once you reach, check in to the hotel. Later, you can relax for the day or explore the city on your own. You can visit Bentota Beach, known for its long stretch of golden sand & clear waters. Alternatively, you can visit Galapata Raja Maha Vihara, an ancient Buddhist temple believed to date back over 1,000 years. If you wish you can also explore Brief Garden, famous for its unique design & lush surroundings.

days.title: Bentota | Madu River Safari, Water Sports & Turtle Hatchery
days.desc: Today, begin the day with a visit to Madu River. Once there, enjoy a boat ride that will take you through winding waterways, passing small islands, cinnamon plantations & diverse wildlife, including colorful birds. Next, enjoy water spots, which include the thrilling jet ski, tube ride & banana boat ride. After that, visit Kosgoda Sea Turtle Hatchery, which offers visitors the chance to learn about sea turtle conservation efforts in Sri Lanka.
